source: User report on opening DoomTrace after R308 installation
reportedFreeAndMax: all-zero digits; exact digit count not specified
interpretation: Stage30 is entered after control state finished==1 during recovery. It groups JOIN, cleanup balance, registry identity, rmmod and postconditions. It does not identify the failing operation or prove unload. FREE/MAX start at zero and are only updated on START, so this report does not establish zero available RAM.
nextConstraint: Do not reopen or retry START, force unload, reboot, or delete DoomRAM/WAD resources. Ask whether CLOSED appeared and whether normal return works. Any future payload must retain ownership and cleanup guards.
